message: lefthook has install scripts that npm will not run because ignore-scripts in .npmrc turns them off; they only do a task of the project: it runs lefthook install, which installs the git hooks of the repository
fix: Add lefthook to installScripts.deny in depcurfew.json, and run lefthook install after each clone: ignore-scripts in .npmrc also keeps npm from running the prepare script of the project
